notes.title: SPECIAL MICRO RPG + WINTER BLOODBATH EVENT
notes.content:
A special in-depth look at our first-person horror and murder mystery game, where the murder victim happens to be you! Play as an unfortunate pizza-delivery guy called Macario Macabro as he explores a haunted mansion full of people who want to eat him. Featuring creepy puzzles, zany dialogue, and rooms that make you lose your mind, have a new look at the weird world of [b][u]Tamarindo’s Freaking Dinner.[/u][/b]

[previewyoutube=vgLZgL24Yg0;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][u]And as a special treat - Marley&Marley - Holiday themed micro RPG for you to play for FREE![/u][/b]

[previewyoutube=WRCLcF95olY;full][/previewyoutube]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1484760/Tamarindos_Freaking_Dinner/?snr=1_1056_4_franchise_1057&curator_clanid=32940668


[h3]WINTER BLOODBATH [/h3]
[url=http://Discord.gg/nd][u][b]Our Discord[/b][/u][/url] is also having its Winter Bloodbath event. We will have a trivia game where people who can answer all the questions right have a chance to win a Nintendo Switch! The server will also host a meme contest where you are encouraged to meme about the Winter Direct and Vlad’s maid outfit. The first-place winner gets 10,000 doctrines!
[url=https://forms.gle/bLMH4gky8sb3dBzr8][b]Trivia Questions Here![/b][/url]


[h3]SWITCH GIVEAWAY[/h3]
Finally, as it is the season for giving, we also announced a giveaway for a Nintendo Switch using codes displayed during the Winter Direct. Best of luck to everyone!
[b][url=https://forms.gle/oKBgWWFff3tsqoFWA]Submit the Code from the video here![/url][/b]


[previewyoutube=_CtcIH-ffbw;full][/previewyoutube]


We hope you enjoyed our announcements and are looking forward to both our new games and our little contests. 2021 was one wild rollercoaster, and we could not have asked for a better community to ride with. Have a fantastic winter everyone!
